'''Kammie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. 

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] her flight flew to fend off the [[Battle at TFP-9|attack]] on [[Station TFP-9]]; in the first phase of the assault, [[Keela Egast]] accused Kammie that she couldn't hit even one of the enemy [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]].

She was killed by [[Bravo Eight]], [[Dren Melne]].
